source._comment: LIVE. Montana SoS 'Montana Absentee Ballots By County' Tableau dashboard (sosmt.gov/elections/absentee-ballot-count/). MT has no party registration -> turnout-only; the dashboard tracks absentee ballots SENT vs RECEIVED by county (cast = received). Fetched via the Tableau bootstrapSession flow (startSession -> bootstrapSession -> parse the 'Absentee Map' worksheet: County, SUM(Ballots Received), SUM(Ballots Sent), AGG(% Received)). tableau-ext.mt.gov is NOT bot-blocked, so this works from CI.
